source.section: Form 540 lines 13 to 19 and 31 to 33 (PDF pages 39-40); PDF page 13 Line 18 standard deduction chart and Line 31; PDF page 75 Tax Rate Schedules; PDF page 39 Form 540 lines 7 and 9 ('X $153'); PDF page 12 Line 7 and Line 9; PDF page 14 Line 32 and the AGI Limitation Worksheet lines a to i; PDF page 60 Schedule CA (540) Line 6 (Social Security excluded)

worked: Married filing jointly, both 70: private pensions 60,000 and 30,000, Social Security 40,000 and 25,000 (gross 65,000). Federal taxable Social Security (given): provisional income 90,000 + 32,500 = 122,500; 85% x (122,500 - 44,000) + 6,000 = 72,725, limited to 85% x 65,000 = 55,250. Federal AGI = 90,000 + 55,250 = 145,250. Form 540 line 13 federal AGI = 145,250.00. Federal taxable income = 145,250.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age-65 addition = 110,550.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Subtractions: Schedule CA (540) line 6 column B, taxable Social Security excluded in full 55,250.00. Schedule CA Part I line 27 column B = 55,250.00 = Form 540 line 14. Additions (line 16): 0.00. Line 15 = line 17 California AGI = 145,250.00 - 55,250.00 = 90,000.00. Line 18 California standard deduction (married filing jointly, PDF page 13 chart) 11,412.00. Line 19 taxable income = 90,000.00 - 11,412.00 = 78,588.00. Tax on 78,588.00 by the projection's brackets: 22,158.00 x 1% = 221.58; 30,370.00 x 2% = 607.40; 26,060.00 x 4% = 1,042.40; total 1,871.38. Line 31: the form uses the Tax Table for taxable income of 100,000 or less; the row 78,551-78,650 gives 1,872 (formula result kept in expected). Line 32 exemption credits: federal AGI 145,250.00 is not more than 504,411.00, so no AGI limitation; line 7 personal 2 x 153 = 306.00; line 9 senior 2 x 153 = 306.00; line 32 = 612.00. Line 33 = 1,871.38 - 612.00 = 1,259.38; no other credits (lines 34 to 47 nil), line 48 = 1,259.38. State income tax = 1,259.38.
accepted_approximations: Taxable income of 100,000 or less is taxed by the Tax Table (100-dollar rows, tax at the row midpoint); the projection uses the schedules' exact arithmetic.
